description: Water supply network of Gulberg subdivision, Lahore is a data set listed in opendata.com.pk, an open data portal, published or maintained by The Urban Unit. Data contains water supply lines, Tube wells and overhead reservoir of Gulberg Subdivision of WASA Lahore in Shapefile format. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher The Urban Unit. Its tags are Water supply, pipe condition, tubewell location. The portal shows 2021-04-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-pk-portal.
